summary.scope: 25 frozen PhenoBench images: 5 development, 20 official validation. Public dataset only; no farm-level generalization claim.
summary.status: Assisted-review prototype. Weed recognition target not met.
limitations: Only three positive weed predictions in evaluation; precision is not a robust generalization estimate.
Missed and uncertain plants stay in the recall denominator.
Axis-aligned boxes matched greedily one-to-one at IoU 0.5; partial border instances included.
UAV public images are not evidence of Japanese phone-camera or real-farmer performance.
No crop reference is enabled by default; development reference comparison increased crop-as-weed errors.
Native video completed with zero candidates; no successful movement identity validation is claimed.
No GPS, metric area, treatment, hardware actuation, time savings or pesticide reduction measured.

selection.criterion: development weed F1 minus 2*crop-as-weed rate; ties precision, then simpler strategy; frozen before evaluation
